admission.justification: Binds sparse reads to committed bytes: a skipped worktree is a stated skip, never an assumed-unchanged silent pass.

alternatives.option: Sparse-absent paths read committed bytes and keep skip-worktree; assume-unchanged is cleared otherwise.
alternatives.reason: Assuming unchanged without reading would certify bytes the read never saw.

alternatives.option: Assume unchanged for sparse-absent paths without reading.
alternatives.reason: Certifies bytes the read never saw.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Sparse absence gains a governed attestation distinct from a read.

consequences: Sparse-path reads keep the committed-bytes rule and clear assume-unchanged whenever the path is actually read.
context: MIK-R74 rule 5 sparse blobs: every consumer builds text trees plus build_index; sparse absence is handled at the read, not the cache.
